stories.title: Location Tracking Preference Management
stories.user_story: As a consumer, I want to change my location tracking preference between 'always', 'only when app is open', and 'off' at any time, so that I maintain granular control over how my location data is used
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the Privacy Settings screen, When it loads, Then I see my current location tracking preference highlighted among three options: 'Always', 'Only when app is open', 'Off'
Given I select a different preference, When I tap 'Save', Then my choice is persisted with a timestamp and the corresponding OS permission dialog is triggered if escalating permissions
Given I downgrade from 'Always' to 'Off', When I save, Then location data collection stops immediately and no new geofence events are processed for my account
Given I set tracking to 'Off', When I view the offers feed, Then I see non-personalised offers with a banner: 'Enable location for nearby offers'
Given a screen reader is active, When navigating the tracking options, Then each option announces its label and current selection state (e.g., 'Always — selected')
stories.regulatory_linkage: GDPR Art. 7 — conditions for consent; must be as easy to withdraw as to give
stories.reasoning: Core privacy control. 3 points: three-state toggle + OS permission sync + immediate effect on data pipeline. Confidential as it governs PII collection behaviour.

stories.title: OS Permission Sync with App Preference
stories.user_story: As a consumer, I want my in-app location preference to stay in sync with my OS-level location permission, so that I am not confused by conflicting settings
acceptance_criteria: Given I revoke location permission at OS level, When I next open the app, Then my in-app preference is automatically updated to 'Off' and a toast confirms: 'Location tracking turned off — update in Settings to re-enable'

Given my in-app preference is 'Always' but OS is set to 'While Using', When the app detects the mismatch on launch, Then the in-app preference downgrades to 'Only when app is open' and I see an informational banner
Given I upgrade OS permission from 'While Using' to 'Always', When the app detects the change, Then my in-app preference is updated to 'Always' only if I previously requested 'Always'
Given a screen reader is active, When the sync toast or banner appears, Then it is announced as a live region update
Then location preference changes are recorded in an immutable audit log with timestamp and previous value
stories.regulatory_linkage: GDPR Art. 7 — consent withdrawal must be effective regardless of mechanism
stories.reasoning: Separate from US-054 because OS sync is a distinct technical challenge (app lifecycle hooks, background detection). 3 points: platform-specific APIs (iOS CLLocationManager, Android FusedLocationProvider) + mismatch resolution logic.

stories.title: Data Sharing Opt-Out
stories.user_story: As a consumer, I want to stop sharing my transaction data with the offers platform and delete my spending profile, so that my financial behaviour is no longer used for offer targeting
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the Privacy Settings screen, When I tap 'Stop sharing transaction data', Then a confirmation dialog explains the impact: 'You will no longer receive personalised offers based on spending. Generic offers remain available.'
Given I confirm the opt-out, When the action completes, Then transaction sync stops within 60 seconds and my spending profile is queued for deletion within 24 hours
Given my spending profile has been deleted, When I view the offers feed, Then I see generic location-based offers without spending-category personalisation
Given I later re-enable data sharing, When I toggle it on, Then a new spending profile begins building from that point forward (no historical backfill)
Given a screen reader is active, When the confirmation dialog appears, Then the dialog title, body, and action buttons are announced in sequence
Given the opt-out request is submitted, When the backend processes it, Then an audit log entry is created with user ID, timestamp, and action type, encrypted at rest with CMEK
stories.regulatory_linkage: GDPR Art. 7(3) — right to withdraw consent; CCPA §1798.120 — right to opt-out of sale/sharing
stories.reasoning: 5 points: pipeline stop + profile deletion + graceful degradation + audit trail. Restricted because it involves deletion of financial behavioural data and requires cryptographic audit logging.

stories.title: Account & Data Deletion Request
stories.user_story: As a consumer, I want to request full deletion of my account and all associated data, so that I can exercise my right to be forgotten
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the Account Settings screen, When I tap 'Delete my account', Then I see a summary of what will be deleted (profile, location history, spending data, offer interactions) and a 7-day cooling-off notice
Given I confirm deletion, When the request is submitted, Then I receive an email confirmation with a link to cancel within 7 days, and my account enters 'pending deletion' state
Given my account is in 'pending deletion' state, When I log in within 7 days, Then I see a banner: 'Your account is scheduled for deletion on [date]. Tap here to cancel.'
Given 7 days elapse without cancellation, When the cooling-off period expires, Then a Pub/Sub event is published to all downstream services triggering data purge within 30 days
Given all services confirm deletion, When the 30-day window completes, Then no PII remains in any system and a deletion certificate is logged
Given a screen reader is active, When the deletion summary screen loads, Then all data categories and the cooling-off timeline are announced clearly
Given the deletion request is submitted, When the backend processes it, Then the request is authenticated via the user's current session token and the Pub/Sub message is signed to prevent spoofing
stories.regulatory_linkage: GDPR Art. 17 — right to erasure; CCPA §1798.105 — right to deletion
stories.reasoning: 5 points: multi-step flow (request → cooling-off → Pub/Sub fan-out → cross-service purge → certificate). Restricted due to irreversible data destruction and cross-service coordination. Security AC covers auth and message integrity.

stories.title: Deletion Cancellation During Cooling-Off
stories.user_story: As a consumer who requested account deletion, I want to cancel my deletion request within the 7-day cooling-off period, so that I can retain my account if I change my mind
acceptance_criteria: Given my account is in 'pending deletion' state, When I tap 'Cancel deletion' from the in-app banner or email link, Then my account is immediately restored to active state
Given I cancel via the email link, When I tap the cancellation link, Then I am redirected to the app with a confirmation: 'Deletion cancelled — your account is active'
Given the 7-day period has expired, When I attempt to cancel, Then I see: 'The cancellation window has closed. Contact support for assistance.'
Given a screen reader is active, When the cancellation confirmation appears, Then the success message is announced as a live region
Then the deletion request is authenticated via biometric/password before processing, and the request itself is logged immutably
stories.regulatory_linkage: GDPR Art. 17 — right to erasure (cooling-off is a consumer protection measure)
stories.reasoning: 2 points: state transition (pending → active) + email deep link + time-window enforcement. Simpler than the deletion itself as it reverses a single flag.

stories.title: Report an Offer
stories.user_story: As a consumer, I want to report an offer as expired, invalid, or inappropriate, so that the platform can maintain offer quality and protect other users
acceptance_criteria: Given I am viewing an offer detail screen, When I tap the 'Report' icon, Then I see a bottom sheet with three options: 'Expired', 'Invalid/misleading', 'Inappropriate content'
Given I select a reason and optionally add a comment (max 500 chars), When I tap 'Submit', Then the report is recorded and I see: 'Thanks — we'll review this offer'
Given I have already reported this offer, When I tap 'Report' again, Then I see: 'You've already reported this offer' and the submit button is disabled
Given a screen reader is active, When the report bottom sheet opens, Then focus moves to the sheet title and options are announced as a radio group
stories.reasoning: 2 points: simple form submission + duplicate prevention. Internal sensitivity as reports don't contain PII beyond user ID.

stories.title: Auto-Pause Offer on Report Threshold
stories.user_story: As a platform operator, I want offers that receive 3 or more reports to be automatically paused pending review, so that potentially harmful or misleading offers are removed quickly
acceptance_criteria: Given an offer accumulates 3 unique reports, When the 3rd report is submitted, Then the offer status changes to 'paused' and it is no longer visible to consumers
Given an offer is auto-paused, When a platform operator views the moderation queue, Then the offer appears with report count, reasons breakdown, and user comments
Given a platform operator reviews a paused offer, When they select 'Reinstate' or 'Remove permanently', Then the offer status updates accordingly and the merchant is notified
Given a screen reader is active, When the operator navigates the moderation queue, Then each item announces offer title, report count, and available actions
stories.reasoning: 3 points: threshold counter + auto-pause logic + admin review UI + merchant notification. Separate from reporting as it's a backend/operator workflow.

stories.title: Request Data Export
stories.user_story: As a consumer, I want to request an export of all my personal data in a machine-readable format, so that I can exercise my right to data portability
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the Privacy Settings screen, When I tap 'Export my data', Then I see a description: 'We'll prepare a JSON file with your profile, location history, offer interactions, and preferences. You'll receive an email when it's ready.'
Given I confirm the export request, When the request is submitted, Then an async job is queued and I see: 'Export requested — you'll receive an email within 24 hours'
Given the export job completes, When the file is ready, Then I receive an email with a secure download link valid for 24 hours
Given I tap the download link within 24 hours, When the file downloads, Then it is a valid JSON file conforming to a documented schema containing all my personal data held by the platform
Given the download link has expired (>24 hours), When I tap it, Then I see: 'This link has expired. Request a new export from the app.'
Given a screen reader is active, When the export confirmation screen loads, Then the timeline and next steps are announced clearly
Given the export file is generated, When it is stored for download, Then it is encrypted at rest with CMEK and the download link uses a signed URL with 24-hour expiry
stories.regulatory_linkage: GDPR Art. 20 — right to data portability; CCPA §1798.100 — right to know/access
stories.reasoning: 5 points: async job orchestration + data aggregation across services + JSON schema + signed URL generation + email notification + expiry enforcement. Restricted because the export contains all user PII in one file. Security AC covers encryption and signed URLs.
